title: WinoQueer-NL: Assessing Bias in Dutch Language Models toward LGBTQ+ Identities

bias_targets.target: Sexual orientation and gender identity bias
bias_targets.methodology: Comparing the log-likelihoods (pseudo-log-likelihoods for MLMs and standard log-likelihoods for ARLMs) of stereotypical versus counter-stereotypical sentence pairs created by substituting LGBTQ+ identity terms with non-LGBTQ+ identity terms.

primary_bias_target: Sexual orientation and gender identity bias
